title: 定语从句的组织
goal: 能确定关系词的成分并将从句接到正确的先行词后。

points.label: 判断关系词在从句中的成分
将定语从句接到正确先行词后

sources.title: 大学英语六级考试大纲

body.p: 中文定语里有动作或判断时，可以译成英文定语从句。从句紧跟在被修饰的先行词后面。关系词在从句里作主语、作宾语，或者表示所属。

body.box:
原文：修复石桥的工匠住在附近的村庄。
译文：The craftsperson who repaired the stone bridge lives in a nearby village.

cards.title: 关系词的成分
rows: 主语：指人用 who
修复钟表的工匠住在这个小镇。
The craftsperson who repairs clocks lives in the town.
主语：指物用 which 或 that
穿过农田的小路通向山谷。
The path that crosses the fields leads to the valley.
宾语：指物用 which 或 that
学生修复的模型放在展厅里。
The model that students restored is in the gallery.
宾语：指人可用 who 或 whom
研究人员采访的画家居住在海边。
The painter whom researchers interviewed lives by the sea.
所属：whose 加名词
屋顶受到损坏的房屋暂时关闭。
The house whose roof was damaged is temporarily closed.
所属：指人也用 whose
作品在展厅展出的画家来自小镇。
The painter whose works are displayed in the gallery comes from the town.

cards.title: 先行词与范围
rows: 必要限定
住在河边的农民种植水稻。
The farmers who live by the river grow rice.
必要限定
保存在仓库里的照片需要整理。
The photographs that are kept in the storeroom need sorting.
补充说明
这座博物馆位于港口，收藏古老的航海图。
The museum, which is near the port, holds old nautical charts.
补充说明
这位教师来自小镇，教授木工课程。
The teacher, who comes from the town, teaches woodworking.
对应物品
学生参观了收藏古代陶器的博物馆。
Students visited the museum that holds ancient pottery.
对应人物
学生采访了收藏古代陶器的画家。
Students interviewed the painter who collects ancient pottery.

items.stem: 原文：修理自行车的技师住在车站附近。选择译句。
options: The mechanic who repairs bicycles lives near the station.
The mechanic which repairs bicycles lives near the station.
The mechanic lives near the station that repairs bicycles.
The mechanic whose bicycles are repaired lives near the station.
items.why: 修理自行车的是技师，who 指 mechanic，在从句里作 repairs 的主语。第二项用 which 指人。

items.stem: 原文：村民修复的石桥连接两个村庄。选择译句。
options: The stone bridge that restored villagers connects two villages.
The stone bridge that villagers restored connects two villages.
The villagers who restored the stone bridge connect two villages.
The stone bridge that villagers restored it connects two villages.
items.why: 村民修复石桥，that 指 stone bridge，作 restored 的宾语，从句里不再加 it。

items.stem: 原文：屋顶漏水的图书馆正在接受修缮。排列译句。
items.why: whose roof 表达屋顶属于图书馆。

items.stem: 原文：研究人员参观了保存旧地图的档案馆。排列译句。
items.why: that holds old maps 紧接 archive，修饰档案馆。

items.stem: 原文：作者采访的渔民住在海边的村庄。选择译句。
options: The author who interviewed the fishermen lives in a coastal village.
The fishermen who interviewed the author live in a coastal village.
The fishermen whom the author interviewed live in a coastal village.
The fishermen whom the author interviewed them live in a coastal village.
items.why: 作者采访渔民，whom 指 fishermen，作 interviewed 的宾语。住在海边村庄的是渔民，即第三项。

items.stem: 原文：通向港口的小路穿过一片树林。排列译句。
items.why: that leads to the port 紧接 path，修饰小路。

items.stem: 原文：修理木船的工匠居住在这个港口。选择译句。
options: The craftsperson which repairs wooden boats lives at the port.
The craftsperson lives at the port that repairs wooden boats.
The wooden boats that the craftsperson repairs are at the port.
The craftsperson who repairs wooden boats lives at the port.
items.why: 修理木船的是工匠，who 指人，在从句里作 repairs 的主语。第一项用 which 指人。

items.stem: 原文：学生整理的信件存放在学校档案室。选择译句。
options: The letters that students sorted are kept in the school archive.
The letters that students sorted them are kept in the school archive.
The letters are kept in the school archive that students sorted.
The letters whose students sorted are kept in the school archive.
items.why: 学生整理信件，that 指 letters，作 sorted 的宾语。第二项在从句里多了 them。

items.stem: 原文：屋顶涂成蓝色的房屋位于河边。选择译句。
options: The house which roof is painted blue stands beside the river.
The house whose roof is painted blue stands beside the river.
The house stands beside the river whose roof is painted blue.
The house that is painted blue stands beside the river.
items.why: 屋顶属于房屋，用 whose roof 表示所属，从句紧跟 house。第四项把整座房屋说成涂成蓝色。

items.stem: 原文：学生采访了收藏古代陶器的画家。选择译句。
options: Students who collect ancient pottery interviewed the painter.
Students interviewed the painter which collects ancient pottery.
Students interviewed the painter who collects ancient pottery.
Students collected the ancient pottery of the painter they interviewed.
items.why: 收藏古代陶器的是画家，who collects ancient pottery 紧跟 painter。第一项把从句接到了 students 后面。

items.stem: 原文：馆长修复的古画现在陈列在展厅。排列译句。
items.why: that 指 painting，是 restored 的宾语。

items.stem: 原文：窗户朝南的教室白天光线充足。排列译句。
items.why: whose windows 表达教室与窗户的所属关系。

items.stem: 原文：研究人员参观了种植竹子的农场。排列译句。
items.why: that grows bamboo 紧接 farm，说明农场种植的作物。

items.stem: 原文：教授采访了记录当地戏曲的音乐家。排列译句。
items.why: who records local opera 修饰 musician，音乐家是记录者。
